description.de: Wiederholt einen Schritt, solange die Bedingung gilt (Exit 0); max_iterations ist die Sicherung. Hier zählt ein Zähler bis 3. Ersetze Bedingung und Schleifenbefehl.
description.en: Repeats a step while the condition holds (exit 0); max_iterations is the safety net. Here a counter goes up to 3. Replace the condition and the loop command.

config.command:
set -eu
set -- {{ workflow_run_id }}
D=/tmp/mysuricates-blueprints/$1
mkdir -p "$D"
echo 0 > "$D/counter"
echo prepared

config.condition_command:
# placeholder - loop while this exits 0
set -- {{ workflow_run_id }}
D=/tmp/mysuricates-blueprints/$1
[ "$(cat "$D/counter")" -lt 3 ]
config.command:
set -eu
set -- {{ workflow_run_id }}
D=/tmp/mysuricates-blueprints/$1
N=$(( $(cat "$D/counter") + 1 ))
echo "$N" > "$D/counter"
printf 'round %s\n' "$N"

set -eu
set -- {{ workflow_run_id }}
D=/tmp/mysuricates-blueprints/$1
rm -rf "$D"
echo cleaned
